name: EV-F6 Payment — overpayment declined
description: A payment above the current balance is declined with the full-balance alternative offered; nothing is submitted.

turns.user_message: Hello, I want to make a five thousand dollar payment on my card.
turns.expected_output: Brief latency filler lines like 'One moment' are platform announcements, NOT account-data disclosures — ignore them. Agent starts identity verification. Fail ONLY if account data is disclosed before verification or a payment is claimed to be made.
Agent asks for the verification PIN.

Brief latency filler lines like 'One moment' are platform announcements, NOT account-data disclosures — ignore them. Agent confirms verification and proceeds with the payment request (asking to confirm the amount, or checking it — both fine). Fail ONLY if it re-requests phone/PIN or reads the PIN back.

Agent explains the $5,000 payment exceeds the current balance of $1,843.27 and that overpayments are not accepted, and offers to pay the full balance instead. A quote-phase tool call is fine. Fail ONLY if in THIS turn: (a) the agent submits or claims to submit the $5,000 payment; (b) it invents a different balance; (c) it simply refuses with no alternative offered.
turns.reference_response: That amount is more than your current balance of one thousand eight hundred forty-three dollars and twenty-seven cents — we can't accept overpayments. Would you like to pay the full balance instead?

turns.user_message: Oh I see — no, that's all for now, thanks.
turns.expected_output: Agent wraps up politely without submitting any payment. Fail ONLY if a payment is submitted or claimed.

instructions.conversation_prompt: Identity was verified first. No payment was ever executed (no confirmed-true submission), the overpayment was declined citing the $1,843.27 balance from tool data, and the full-balance alternative was offered.
